page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr6e.26xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal compute offering in the ECS Bare Metal server family. It is designed for compute-dense, memory-heavy workloads, delivering 104 dedicated vCPUs without virtualization contention. The hardware configuration supplies 768 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of approximately 7.38 GB of memory per core. Operating with KVM virtualization capabilities, this bare-metal platform provides full access to physical host resources for deterministic execution.

Network connectivity is provisioned with a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, facilitating rapid data movement across distributed services. The instance features no bundled local storage disks or integrated GPU accelerators, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Consequently, all persistent state and operational file systems must rely on network-attached block storage devices, creating an architectural separation between execution resources and persistent disks.

In terms of resource density, pairing 104 dedicated execution cores with 768 GB of RAM provides cost efficiency for enterprise organizations aiming to streamline per-socket or per-core licensing overheads. While external storage dependency must be accounted for in system architecture, the high baseline network capacity ensures consistent remote storage IOPS. This profile is suited for memory-intensive workloads including large in-memory databases, distributed caches, enterprise resource planning systems, and large-scale data analytics pipelines.
